title: BeruiiuMaoMao
description: Turn the health bar, sun, and moon into cute cat heads. Replace hunger with cooked fish, and armor value with boxes, etc.
body:
将血条换成猫猫头，不同状态下的血条会变成不同的猫猫头，比如凋零状态的玩家血条会变成黑猫；
将饱腹度换成熟鱼，兼容苹果皮模组；
将护甲值换成猫猫躲起来的箱子；
将经验条换成粉色；
物品栏加入两个猫猫头，中间还有“喵呜喵”字眼；
太阳替换成一个猫猫头，每种状态下的月亮也有不同的猫猫头显示；
玩家默认皮肤也换成了不同的猫娘皮肤和一些非猫娘皮肤。

Replace the health bar with cat heads. The health bar will take on different shapes depending on the player's status. For example, a player in withered state will have a black cat as their health bar.
Converts hunger level to mature fish, compatible with Apple Peel module;
Replace armor value with the boxes where the cat hides;
Change the experience bar to pink;
Two cat heads are added to the inventory, with the words "Meow Meow Meow" in between.
The sun is replaced with a cat head, and the moon displays different cat heads in various states.
The default player skins have also been changed to various catgirl skins and some non-catgirl skins.
（Machine translation may contain language errors. Please forgive us.）
